engines.name: Google Search
engines.description: Scrapes Google web search results (organic results, knowledge graph, local pack, related questions, AI Overview token and more) as JSON, with location, date and language controls.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query to search; supports operators such as inurl:, site:, intitle: and advanced params like as_dt/as_eq. site: cannot be used with tbm=nws.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: Where the search originates. Most popular match is used if several match; city level recommended (see /locations.json). Cannot be used with uule. Can also be combined with gl for consistent country filtering.

params.name: uule
params.label: UULE (encoded location)
params.help: Google-encoded location. Cannot be used together with location. A matching gl is needed for coordinate-based uule. Use SerpApi's UULE Generator to create one.

params.name: lat
params.label: GPS latitude
params.help: GPS latitude of the search origin. Required when lon is used; use a matching gl. Cannot be combined with location/uule.

params.name: lon
params.label: GPS longitude
params.help: GPS longitude of the search origin. Required when lat is used; use a matching gl. Cannot be combined with location/uule.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius (meters)
params.help: Distance in meters to bias results. Range per device: desktop 1..199, tablet 1..1000, mobile 1..1000. Usable with location or lat/lon.

params.name: ludocid
params.label: Place CID (ludocid)
params.help: Google CID (customer identifier) of a place; found as place_id in Google Search/Local results or data_cid in Google Maps results.

params.name: lsig
params.label: Knowledge graph map view (lsig)
params.help: Forces the knowledge graph map view to show up; the lsig ID is found via the Local Pack API or Google Local API.

params.name: kgmid
params.label: Knowledge Graph ID (kgmid)
params.help: Google Knowledge Graph ID (KGMID) of the listing to scrape. For some searches it overrides all other parameters except start.

params.name: si
params.label: Cached search params (si)
params.help: Cached search parameters of the Google search to scrape; for some searches overrides everything except start. Can scrape Knowledge Graph tabs.

params.name: ibp
params.label: Layout/expansion (ibp)
params.help: Renders layouts and expansions for some elements (e.g. gwp;0,7 to expand searches with ludocid for an expanded knowledge graph).

params.name: uds
params.label: Filter string (uds)
params.help: Google-provided filter string; values come from the filters section of a response (uds, q and serpapi_link per filter).

params.name: color_scheme
params.label: Color scheme
params.help: Forces the color scheme of the results page. If unset a random scheme is returned.

params.name: google_domain
params.label: Google domain
params.help: Google domain to use, e.g. google.com (default), google.co.uk, google.ca.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code for the Google search (e.g. us, uk, fr).

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code for the Google search: two or three letters (en, es, fr), optionally with region (en-gb, es-419).

params.name: cr
params.label: Limit to countries (cr)
params.help: One or more countries to limit the search to, as country{ISO2 upper-case} delimited by | (e.g. countryFR|countryDE).

params.name: lr
params.label: Limit to languages (lr)
params.help: One or more languages to limit the search to, as lang_{code} delimited by | (e.g. lang_fr|lang_de).

params.name: tbs
params.label: Advanced filters (tbs)
params.help: (to be searched) Advanced search parameters not possible in the regular query field (e.g. date ranges, patents, news, videos, images, apps, text content).

params.name: safe
params.label: Adult content filter
params.help: Level of filtering for adult content: active or off. By default Google blurs explicit content.

params.name: nfpr
params.label: Exclude auto-corrected results
params.help: 1 excludes results from an auto-corrected query when the original is misspelled; 0 includes them (default). May not prevent auto-corrected results if nothing else is available.

params.name: filter
params.label: Similar/omitted results filter
params.help: 1 (default) enables the 'Similar Results' and 'Omitted Results' filters; 0 disables them.

params.name: tbm
params.label: Search type (tbm)
params.help: Type of search: none = regular Google search; isch Images, lcl Local, vid Videos, nws News, shop Shopping, pts Patents, or any other Google service value.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset (start)
params.help: Result offset used for pagination: 0 (default) is page 1, 10 is page 2, 20 is page 3, etc.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (iPad) or mobile.

pagination.notes: 0 = first page, 10 = second page, 20 = third, etc.

engines.aira_use: Research any employer, salary range, interview question or hiring manager with real Google results, and get the AI Overview, knowledge graph and People Also Ask for a company in one call.

engines.name: Google AI Mode
engines.description: Scrapes Google AI Mode answers: generated text blocks, references, inline media and shopping results, with optional multi-turn follow-up conversations.

params.name: q
params.label: Prompt
params.help: Query/prompt for Google AI Mode. Multiple languages (including English) may be supported, though not all are available yet.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: Where the search originates. Most popular match is used if several match; city level recommended (see /locations.json). Cannot be used with uule.

params.name: uule
params.label: UULE (encoded location)
params.help: Google-encoded location. Cannot be used together with location. A matching gl is needed for coordinate-based uule. Use SerpApi's UULE Generator to create one.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code for the Google search (e.g. us, uk, fr).

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code for the Google search: two or three letters (en, es, fr), optionally with region (en-gb, es-419).

params.name: continuable
params.label: Make conversation continuable
params.help: Set true to receive a subsequent_request_token that lets you ask a follow-up (multi-turn). Defaults to false.

params.name: subsequent_request_token
params.label: Follow-up token
params.help: Token returned by a previous request (with continuable=true) used to send a follow-up in the same conversation. Include a new q and reuse the same gl, hl and location.

params.name: image_url
params.label: Image URL
params.help: URL of an image to include in the prompt as additional context for the AI answer.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (iPad) or mobile.

pagination.notes: Use continuable + subsequent_request_token for multi-turn follow-ups.

engines.aira_use: Ask Google's AI for a sourced briefing on a company, role, interview process or salary band, then chain follow-up questions in the same conversation.

engines.name: Google AI Overview
engines.description: Fetches the full Google AI Overview for a search using the ai_overview.page_token returned by the Google Search API (token expires within 1 minute).

params.name: page_token
params.label: AI Overview page token
params.help: Token to fetch the AI Overview from: use ai_overview.page_token from a Google Search API response. It expires within 1 minute of the search, so use it immediately.

engines.aira_use: Expand the AI summary Google shows for a company or role query into full text and cited sources for research notes.

engines.name: Google Gemini
engines.description: Scrapes Google Gemini answers (text blocks, references, places, products, images, follow-up questions) with multi-turn conversation support.

params.name: q
params.label: Prompt
params.help: The prompt to send to Google Gemini.

params.name: subsequent_request_token
params.label: Follow-up token
params.help: Token returned by a previous Gemini request; pass it with a new q to send a follow-up with previous prompts and answers as context. Tokens expire, so follow up soon.

engines.aira_use: Use Gemini as a second-opinion assistant for resume tips, interview prep and company summaries inside Aira.

engines.name: Google Autocomplete
engines.description: Scrapes Google Autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, with support for several clients (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, YouTube and more).

params.name: q
params.label: Partial query
params.help: Search query for which completion options are returned.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code for the Google search (e.g. us, uk, fr).

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code for the Google Autocomplete search: two or three letters (en, es, fr), optionally with region (en-gb, es-419).

params.name: cp
params.label: Cursor position
params.help: Position of the cursor in the query; 0 places the cursor before the query. If omitted the cursor is at the end of the query.

params.name: client
params.label: Client
params.help: Client used for autocomplete.

engines.aira_use: Discover how people actually phrase job and salary searches ('software engineer salary in ...') to pick better keywords for job hunting and resumes.

engines.name: Google Related Questions
engines.description: Expands a People Also Ask question into additional related questions with answers, using a next_page_token from a Google Search response.

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token that shows the extra related questions Google generates when a question is clicked; found in the related_questions block of a Google Search API response.

pagination.notes: Each returned question carries its own next_page_token.

engines.aira_use: Drill into People Also Ask questions about a role or company to build interview-prep question lists.

params.name: tbs
params.label: Advanced filters (tbs)

params.name: safe
params.label: Adult content filter
params.help: Level of filtering for adult content: active or off. By default Google blurs explicit content.

params.name: nfpr
params.label: Exclude auto-corrected results
params.help: 1 excludes results from an auto-corrected query when the original is misspelled; 0 includes them (default). May not prevent auto-corrected results if nothing else is available.

params.name: filter
params.label: Similar/omitted results filter
params.help: 1 (default) enables the 'Similar Results' and 'Omitted Results' filters; 0 disables them.

params.name: start
params.label: Result offset (start)
params.help: Result offset used for pagination: 0 (default) is page 1, 10 is page 2, 20 is page 3, etc.

params.name: device
params.label: Device
params.help: Device used to fetch results: desktop (default), tablet (iPad) or mobile.

engines.name: Google News
engines.description: Scrapes Google News results by query, topic, publication, section, story or knowledge-graph entity, with titles, sources, dates and thumbnails.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: Query to search in Google News; supports operators such as site: and when:. Cannot be used together with any of the advanced token parameters.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code for the Google News search (e.g. us, uk, fr). Default is us.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code for the Google News search: two or three letters (en, es, fr), optionally with region (en-gb, es-419).

params.name: topic_token
params.label: Topic token
params.help: Google News topic token for a topic (e.g. World, Business, Technology); found in the JSON response or in the Google News URL after /topics/. Can be used with section_token.

params.name: kgmid
params.label: Knowledge Graph ID (kgmid)
params.help: Knowledge Graph ID of a topic or location (starts with /m/ or /g/; Freebase ID from Wikidata, e.g. /m/0vzm for Austin, TX). Can only be used alone.

params.name: publication_token
params.label: Publication token
params.help: Google News publication token for a specific publisher (e.g. CNN, BBC); found in the JSON response or the URL after /publications/. Can be used with section_token.

params.name: section_token
params.label: Section token
params.help: Google News section token for a sub-section of a topic (e.g. Business -> Economy); found in the JSON response or the URL after /sections/. Can be used with topic_token, publication_token and so.

params.name: story_token
params.label: Story token
params.help: Google News story token for full coverage of a specific story; found in the JSON response or the URL after /stories/. Can be used with so.

params.name: so
params.label: Sort order
params.help: Sorting method: 0 relevance (default) or 1 date. Can be used with story_token and section_token.

pagination.notes: No pagination parameter is documented; use tokens to navigate topics, sections and stories.

engines.aira_use: Track layoffs, funding rounds, leadership changes and hiring news for target employers before applying or interviewing.

params.name: gl

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code for the Google Event Details search: two or three letters (en, es, fr), optionally with region (en-gb, es-419). Defaults to en. The event About section and venue description are often only available in English.

params.name: similar_events

params.name: search_results
params.label: Include search results
params.help: Set to 1 or true to include a short list of web results related to the event.

engines.name: Google Ads Transparency Center
engines.description: Scrapes Google Ads Transparency Center: ad creatives run by an advertiser (or matching a domain text), with formats, shown dates and regions.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.label: Advertiser ID
params.help: Google Advertiser ID from the Ads Transparency Center advertiser URL (e.g. AR17828074650563772417). Accepts a single ID or several comma-separated IDs; alternatively use text.

params.name: text
params.label: Free-text / domain
params.help: Text to search, typically a domain, as in a standard Ads Transparency Center search. Can replace advertiser_id.

params.name: platform
params.label: Platform
params.help: Platform where ads are displayed. When unset, results from all platforms are returned.

params.name: political_ads
params.label: Political ads only
params.help: When true only political advertisements are returned (a separate category). Defaults to false. Can only be used with region.

params.name: get_advertiser
params.label: Fetch advertiser details
params.help: When true an extra request returns the advertiser block (legal name and country of registration). Defaults to false. Only usable with a single advertiser_id.

params.name: region
params.label: Region
params.help: Region code to search from (numeric Google region ID); default is anywhere. See SerpApi's Ads Transparency Center regions list for all codes.

params.name: start_date
params.label: Start date
params.help: Start date of the results, format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20221201).

params.name: end_date
params.label: End date
params.help: End date of the results, format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20221231). For a single day set end_date to start_date + 1 day.

params.name: creative_format
params.label: Creative format
params.help: Only ads with this format are returned.

params.name: num
params.label: Max results
params.help: Maximum number of results to return (default 40).

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

engines.name: Google Immersive Product
engines.description: Returns the expanded product popup from Google: stores and prices, specs, reviews, videos and more options, using a page_token from a search result.

params.name: page_token
params.label: Page token
params.help: Token needed to show more product info in the Google immersive popup (immersive_product_page_token from search results).

params.name: more_stores

params.help: Set to 1 or true to return up to 13 stores instead of the default 3 to 5.

params.name: next_page_token
params.label: Next page token
params.help: Token for the next page of store results; returned as stores_next_page_token.

engines.name: Google Product
engines.description: Scrapes a Google Shopping product page: stores and prices, price insights, specifications, reviews, top insights and variants.

params.name: product_id
params.label: Product ID
params.help: Google product to get results for; the product_id returned by the Google Shopping API (also in product_link as prds=catalogid:{product_id}). Either product_id or page_token is required.

params.name: page_token
params.label: Page token
params.help: Token of a specific product offer (immersive_product_page_token from Google Shopping, or page_token from this API); selects the exact offer, variant and reviews. Either product_id or page_token is required.

params.name: offer_view
params.label: Offer view
params.help: Set to 1 or true to fetch the offer view of a product_id search (adds rating, reviews, ratings, user_reviews, top_insights, variants). Ignored for page_token searches.

params.name: gl
params.label: Country (gl)
params.help: Two-letter country code for the Google Product search (e.g. us, uk, fr). Defaults to us.

params.name: hl
params.label: Language (hl)
params.help: Language code for the Google Product search: two or three letters (en, es, fr), optionally with region (en-gb, es-419). Defaults to en.

engines.aira_use: Compare prices and reviews for tools, books or equipment you need to buy when starting a new job or course.
